automatable_note: The ESC's own button must be pressed once after the 2 s entry wait. The bench has no actuator for it.

manual.action: Press the button under the shrink tube after 2 s or the tone sequence.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 2 s wait; sequence after the button press.
steps: Connect the motor if tones are to be audible. Transmitter on, throttle to the brake position.
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
Operator: press the button under the shrink tubing on the ESC.
The ESC sounds a tone sequence, then the mode series, with a pause between series.
Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 10 is reached after the 10th tone.
Mode 2 only: move the throttle to a separate motor-off position after the ESC's confirmation.
The ESC repeats the mode. Wait for it, then disconnect power (an interrupted run locks the ESC; 9 LED flashes).

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full while the wanted series sounds.

scheme.description: Throttle at brake, apply power, wait 2 s, press the ESC button. The ESC counts modes as tones (mode 10 after the 10th). Full throttle at the wanted count stores the mode. Mode 10 adds a BEC voltage stage in 0.2 V steps from 5 V.
